Name: Jehiel, Father of Gibeon
Summary: Father of Gibeon who dwelt at Gibeon, whose wife was Maachah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:29; 1 Chronicles 9:35: Father of Gibeon who dwelt at Gibeon, whose wife was Maachah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
